topics.topic: Delivery of ‘Agray’ – ASW Shallow Water Craft
topics.why_in_news: Indian Navy received ‘Agray’, an Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft (ASW SWC), strengthening coastal defence and undersea warfare capabilities in the Indian Ocean Region.
prelims_quick_notes: ASW SWC designed for shallow-water anti-submarine operations.
Strengthens coastal surveillance and maritime security.
Equipped with sonar systems, torpedoes and rocket launchers.
Supports detection and tracking of submarines in shallow waters.
Enhances India’s undersea domain awareness.
Supports SAGAR vision and maritime security strategy.
Promotes indigenous defence manufacturing.
Improves layered naval defence capabilities.
important_facts: Built by Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE), Kolkata.
Uses waterjet propulsion for better manoeuvrability.
Designed under Indian Register of Shipping standards.
Supports network-centric warfare and coastal security operations.
exam_relevance: Important for Internal Security, Defence and Maritime Security.
Useful for Indian Ocean Region and indigenisation topics.
Can be linked with SAGAR, Blue Economy and Atmanirbhar Bharat.
prelims_traps: ASW SWC is designed mainly for shallow-water operations.
SAGAR relates to regional maritime cooperation and security.

topics.why_in_news: Indian Navy hosted IMEX TTX 2026 under the Indian Ocean Naval Symposium framework to strengthen maritime cooperation and address non-traditional maritime security threats in the Indian Ocean Region.
prelims_quick_notes: IMEX TTX conducted under Indian Ocean Naval Symposium (IONS).
Hosted by Indian Navy at Kochi.
Focused on non-traditional maritime security challenges.
Conducted as a table-top exercise in simulated environment.
Enhances interoperability and coordination among participating navies.
Addresses piracy, trafficking and maritime disasters.
Supports maritime domain awareness and regional stability.
Strengthens India’s maritime diplomacy and Indo-Pacific strategy.
important_facts: IONS includes member and observer nations from Indian Ocean Region.
India promotes SAGAR vision through maritime cooperation.
Indian Ocean Region is critical for global trade and energy flows.
Malacca Strait and Strait of Hormuz are major maritime chokepoints.
Table-top exercises are cost-effective strategic simulation exercises.
exam_relevance: Important for Internal Security, International Relations and Maritime Security.
Useful for Indo-Pacific strategy and regional cooperation topics.
Can be linked with SAGAR, Blue Economy and naval diplomacy.
prelims_traps: IMEX TTX is a table-top exercise, not full-scale naval deployment.
IONS focuses on maritime cooperation in Indian Ocean Region.
Non-traditional threats include piracy, trafficking and maritime disasters.

topics.topic: Assistance to States to tackle Cyber Incidents
topics.why_in_news: Government highlighted measures to assist States and Union Territories in tackling rising cyber incidents through capacity building, coordination and cybersecurity infrastructure strengthening.
prelims_quick_notes: Cybersecurity is critical component of national security.
Government supports States through technical and financial assistance.
Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) acts as national cyber incident response agency.
Focus on prevention, detection and response to cyber threats.
Cyber incidents include ransomware, phishing, malware and data breaches.
Cyber awareness and digital hygiene are important preventive measures.
Critical information infrastructure protection is major priority.
Coordination between Centre and States essential for cyber resilience.
important_facts: CERT-In functions under Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).
National Critical Information Infrastructure Protection Centre (NCIIPC) protects critical infrastructure.
Cybercrime reporting portal supports citizen reporting of cyber fraud.
Digitalisation increases cyber vulnerabilities and attack surfaces.
Cybersecurity linked with Digital India and national resilience.
exam_relevance: Important for Internal Security, Cybersecurity and Digital Governance.
Useful for questions on cyber warfare, cybercrime and critical infrastructure protection.
Can be linked with data protection and emerging technologies.
prelims_traps: CERT-In functions under MeitY, not Ministry of Home Affairs.
Cybersecurity includes prevention, detection and response mechanisms.
Critical information infrastructure protection is separate from ordinary IT management.
